cohort: The cohort consisted of 141 patients who underwent pregnancy-related hysterectomy in an academic center between 2009 and 2022.
finding: Urological injuries occurred in 17.7% of patients undergoing obstetric hysterectomy, with previous caesarean deliveries and intraoperative estimated blood loss being independent risk factors.
mod_finding: The number of previous caesarean deliveries was independently associated with urological complications.
